implementation.calendar: Explicit UTC horizon, IANA zone and frozen actual offset intervals bound into the approved immutable hash. Civil daily slots, weekday/holiday filters, missing time skip and first/second/both repeated-time choices. Real historical New York, Lord Howe and Samoa pure calendar cases; live UTC execution uses database time without changing host clock.
implementation.admission: Complete published accepted revision plus publication event at or before due, current file read/list/traversal/checks, exact storage/workflow/receiver binding. Family/file unique input claims survive version replacement; immutable occurrences, claims, normal workflow/delivery intents, cursor, events and retry receipt commit atomically.
implementation.missed_capacity: Explicit skip with polling grace, latest, or bounded all catch-up. Expired occurrence consumes no file. Full active/ordinary delivery capacity preserves cursor and input. Replacement suspends old sending authority without claiming the same revision again.
implementation.authority: Separate preview, saved draft and activation; current account/workflow/file/connection/key/policy and scheduled deadline rechecked by shared Go services and independent SQL guards before attempts and during sends. Independent named-account exact-file dispatch approval stays cumulative. Manual separately authorized workflows are not scheduled intents.
implementation.worker: Explicit --execute, bounded read-only polling without per-poll journal spam, same per-step retry key, ordered typed workflow steps, original lease and monotonically increasing takeover fence. Killed staged worker resumes under original budgets; old staging bytes remain unqualified partials.
implementation.recovery: Read-only remote integrity receipt recovery after cutoff under a stock read-only SFTP receiver; no new attempt/fence/write. Metadata-only workflow-refresh repairs an injected projection failure without receiver contact. Cutoff during staging records safe retry only under same live staging lease/fence; uncertain publication never becomes an automatic retry.
implementation.isolation: Migration 29 adds three forced tenant/partner/actor-RLS relations, 56 total. Actor-private schedule/history and redacted ordinary audit views. Existing current-root workflow permissions only; no new/default grants or bypass role. Credential changes join effect guards; status remains observable.
implementation.bounds: 32 KiB strict requests, 24 KiB canonical definition, unchanged 64 KiB event; 5*366-day horizon, 96 daily clocks, 512 holidays, 64 offset intervals, 100 catch-up, 64 files/active runs, 1..604800s cutoff and 1..3600s grace no greater than cutoff; ordinary 128 pending actor deliveries/eight attempts unchanged.
implementation.surfaces: Shared browser/API/CLI services, approved-workflow picker, receiver/source/calendar review, separate draft/activation/tick/work/suspend actions, private history and exact original-key lost-response recovery. Go-generated plain/encrypted canonical browser fixtures include real repeated local clock labels.
